paite: Ka tapa, ka thute kem in, na kiang ah ka thupiakte kholkhawm in.
Ka thupiakte kem inla hing in; huan ka dan na mittang bang in,
na khutzungte tung ah vial inla; na lungtang suangpek tung ah gelh in.
Pilna kiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu na hi," chi inla, theihsiamna na tanaunu chi in.
Numei lamdang a kipan nang ahon keptheihna ding un, athute a maitangphatnu mikhual a kipan.
Ka inn tohlet a pan ka dakkhia a, tohlet vang kal ah ka en paisuak a;
heading: Numei Thangtat

paite: huan mimawlte lak ah ka en a, tuailaite lak ah ka theikak a, tangval theihsiamna beipa,
a-omna ningchin a kongzing a paisuak a, a-inn lam zuan a pai zelpa;
khomui in, nitaklam in, zan mial bikbek leh khomial ah.
Ngai in, numei khat, kizuak puansilh silh, lungtang kiva in akituahpih a.
Amah ahi lawlaw a, atum tuntun a; akhe a-inn ah a-om ngei kei.
Kongzing a om ton a-om a, mun liante a a-om ton a-om a, ning chiteng abuk zel hi.
Huchi in amah amanta a, amah atawpta a, zummoh maitang toh in akiang ah.
Lemna kithoihnate ka kiang ah a-om; tuni in ka thuchiamte ka peta hi.
Huaiziak in nang tuak ding in ka hong paikhia a, na mel thanuamtak a zong ding in, ka hon muta hi.
Ka tutna nuam pialkhang phah zehoihte a zep, ka phah khinta, Aigupta khau puan gialte toh.
Ka lupna murrah, aloe leh sinamon in ka namtuisakta hi.
Hong pai in, zingsang matan i itna dimtek i la ding; itna in i kilungmuantuah ding.
Ka pasal lah inn ah a-om ngal kei a, khual gamla ah azin hi.
Sum ip akitawi a; kha alik chiang in inn ah ahong pai ding, achi hi.
Athugen siamna in amah akipesakta a, amuk a maitang phatnate in amah asawlmangta hi.
Amah azui pah a, goh ding a bawngtal apai bang in leh mihai bawlhoihna dia sikkhau khihmi bang in;
thal in asin akap pailet tan; thang lam a vasa akintat bang in, huai tuh ahinna gun a hih athei kei hi.
Tu in, ka tapate, huaiziak in hon ngaikhia un, ka kam a thute limsak un.
Na lungtang amah lampi lam ah awn kei henla, lampite lam ah paimang kei hen.
Amah lah tampi liamsa in apai lumletta a; ahi, athahsate mihat tampi ahi uh.
A-inn Sheol zotna lampi ahi, sihna dantante zuan a sukpai.
